- Placeholder strings: `xxx`, `TODO`, `FIXME`, `placeholder`, `example.com`, `test_`, `<your-*>`

287	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION triage_conversation(
288	  p_conversation_id uuid
289	)
290	RETURNS text
291	LANGUAGE plpgsql
292	SECURITY DEFINER
293	SET search_path = public
294	AS $$

296	  v_studio_id   uuid;
297	  v_client_id   uuid;
298	  v_body        text;
299	  v_tag         text;
300	  v_has_booking boolean := false;

304	  SELECT studio_id, client_id
305	  INTO   v_studio_id, v_client_id
306	  FROM   conversations

328	      '%reschedule%', '%move%', '%change%', '%switch%', '%shift%'

332	  -- ── Rule 3: pricing keywords ────────────────────────────────────────────────
333	  ELSIF v_body ILIKE ANY (ARRAY[
334	      '%price%', '%how much%', '%quote%', '%cost%', '%rate%'

345	        AND  b.scheduled_at >= now()
346	        AND  b.scheduled_at <  now() + interval '7 days'
347	        AND  b.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')
348	    )
349	    INTO v_has_booking;
350	
351	    IF v_has_booking THEN
352	      v_tag := 'booking';
353	    ELSE
354	      -- ── Rule 5: deposit paid in last 24h (if payments table accessible) ────
355	      BEGIN
356	        SELECT EXISTS (
357	          SELECT 1
358	          FROM   payments p
359	          WHERE  p.client_id  = v_client_id
360	            AND  p.studio_id  = v_studio_id
361	            AND  p.status     = 'succeeded'
362	            AND  p.metadata->>'kind' = 'deposit_paid'
363	            AND  p.succeeded_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
364	        )
365	        INTO v_has_deposit;
366	      EXCEPTION
367	        WHEN undefined_table THEN
368	          v_has_deposit := false;
369	      END;
370	
371	      IF v_has_deposit THEN
372	        v_tag := 'deposit_paid';
373	      ELSE
374	        -- ── Rule 6: known client, no other signal → client ──────────────────
375	        v_tag := 'client';
376	      END IF;
377	    END IF;
378	  END IF;
379	
380	  -- Persist the resolved tag
381	  UPDATE conversations
382	  SET    triage_tag = v_tag,
383	         updated_at = now()
384	  WHERE  id = p_conversation_id;
385	
386	  RETURN v_tag;
387	END;
388	$$;

391	-- 6. FUNCTION enqueue_auto_reply
392	--    Renders a template for a matched auto-reply rule and inserts
393	--    a queued outbound client_communications row.
394	--    Returns the new comm id, or NULL if cooldown is still active.
395	--    Worker (send-sms / send-email) picks up the queued row.
396	--    SECURITY DEFINER: runs as owner so INSERT into
397	--    client_communications bypasses row-level RLS for auto sends.
398	-- ============================================================
399	
400	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enqueue_auto_reply(
401	  p_conversation_id uuid,
402	  p_rule_id         uuid
403	)
404	RETURNS uuid
405	LANGUAGE plpgsql
406	SECURITY DEFINER
407	SET search_path = public
408	AS $$
409	DECLARE
410	  v_rule            auto_reply_rules%ROWTYPE;
411	  v_template        message_templates%ROWTYPE;
412	  v_conv            conversations%ROWTYPE;
413	  v_studio_name     text;
414	  v_client_fname    text;
415	  v_booking_link    text;
416	  v_rendered_body   text;
417	  v_channel         text;
418	  v_new_comm_id     uuid;
419	BEGIN
420	  -- Load rule
421	  SELECT * INTO v_rule FROM auto_reply_rules WHERE id = p_rule_id;
422	  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_rule.enabled THEN
423	    RETURN NULL;
424	  END IF;
425	
426	  -- Load template
427	  SELECT * INTO v_template FROM message_templates WHERE id = v_rule.template_id;
428	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
429	    RETURN NULL;
430	  END IF;
431	
432	  -- Load conversation
433	  SELECT * INTO v_conv FROM conversations WHERE id = p_conversation_id;
434	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
435	    RETURN NULL;
436	  END IF;
437	
438	  -- Cooldown check: skip if auto-reply was sent within cooldown window
439	  IF v_conv.last_auto_reply_at IS NOT NULL
440	    AND v_conv.last_auto_reply_at > now() - (v_rule.cooldown_minutes * interval '1 minute')
441	  THEN
442	    RETURN NULL;
443	  END IF;
444	
445	  -- Resolve token values — use '' if data unavailable (no error)
446	  SELECT COALESCE(s.name, '')
447	  INTO   v_studio_name
448	  FROM   studios s
449	  WHERE  s.id = v_conv.studio_id;
450	
451	  IF v_conv.client_id IS NOT NULL THEN
452	    SELECT COALESCE(c.first_name, '')
453	    INTO   v_client_fname
454	    FROM   clients c
455	    WHERE  c.id = v_conv.client_id;
456	  ELSE
457	    v_client_fname := '';
458	  END IF;
459	
460	  -- booking_link: construct from studio slug (clients table has no booking_link column)
461	  SELECT COALESCE('/book/' || s.slug, '')
462	  INTO   v_booking_link
463	  FROM   studios s
464	  WHERE  s.id = v_conv.studio_id;
465	
466	  -- Render template body — replace known tokens
467	  v_rendered_body := REPLACE(v_template.body, '{{studio_name}}',       COALESCE(v_studio_name, ''));
468	  v_rendered_body := REPLACE(v_rendered_body, '{{client_first_name}}', COALESCE(v_client_fname, ''));
469	  v_rendered_body := REPLACE(v_rendered_body, '{{booking_link}}',      COALESCE(v_booking_link, ''));
470	
471	  -- Determine channel: map 'voice' conversations to 'sms' for outbound reply
472	  v_channel := CASE
473	    WHEN v_conv.channel = 'voice' THEN 'sms'
474	    WHEN v_conv.channel IN ('sms', 'email') THEN v_conv.channel
475	    ELSE 'sms'   -- fallback for instagram / facebook stubs
476	  END;
477	
478	  -- Insert outbound queued comm
479	  INSERT INTO client_communications (
480	    studio_id,
481	    client_id,
482	    conversation_id,
483	    channel,
484	    direction,
485	    status,
486	    body,
487	    is_internal_note,
488	    metadata
489	  )
490	  VALUES (
491	    v_conv.studio_id,
492	    v_conv.client_id,
493	    p_conversation_id,
494	    v_channel,
495	    'outbound',
496	    'queued',
497	    v_rendered_body,
498	    false,
499	    jsonb_build_object(
500	      'auto_reply',  true,
501	      'rule_id',     p_rule_id::text,
502	      'template_id', v_rule.template_id::text,
503	      'tone',        v_rule.tone
504	    )
505	  )
506	  RETURNING id INTO v_new_comm_id;
507	
508	  -- Stamp the cooldown timestamp on the conversation
509	  UPDATE conversations
510	  SET    last_auto_reply_at = now(),
511	         updated_at         = now()
512	  WHERE  id = p_conversation_id;
513	
514	  RETURN v_new_comm_id;
515	END;
516	$$;

329	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_flash_slot_no_show(p_slot_id uuid)

331	LANGUAGE plpgsql
332	SECURITY DEFINER
333	AS $$
334	DECLARE

342	  FROM flash_event_slots

344	    AND status = 'booked'
345	    AND checked_in_at IS NULL
346	  FOR UPDATE;

488	-- SECTION 12 — RPC: close_flash_event
489	--
490	-- Staff-facing. Marks event completed=now(), returns a summary
491	-- jsonb for the UI close-out modal.
492	-- ============================================================
493	
494	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION close_flash_event(p_event_id uuid)
495	RETURNS jsonb
496	LANGUAGE plpgsql
497	SECURITY DEFINER
498	AS $$
499	DECLARE
500	  v_event          flash_events%ROWTYPE;
501	  v_completed_cnt  int;
502	  v_no_show_cnt    int;
503	  v_slot_rev       bigint;
504	  v_deposit_rev    bigint;
505	  v_top_design_id  uuid;
506	  v_top_design_ttl text;
507	  v_top_design_cnt int;
508	BEGIN
509	  -- Membership guard
510	  PERFORM _flash_assert_studio_member_for_event(p_event_id);
511	
512	  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM flash_events WHERE id = p_event_id;
513	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
514	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'flash_event not found: %', p_event_id;
515	  END IF;
516	
517	  IF v_event.status <> 'published' THEN
518	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event must be published to close; current status: %', v_event.status;
519	  END IF;
520	
521	  -- Transition event to completed
522	  UPDATE flash_events
523	  SET status       = 'completed',
524	      completed_at = now(),
525	      updated_at   = now()
526	  WHERE id = p_event_id;
527	
528	  -- Aggregate slot stats
529	  SELECT
530	    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'booked'),
531	    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'no_show')
532	  INTO v_completed_cnt, v_no_show_cnt
533	  FROM flash_event_slots
534	  WHERE flash_event_id = p_event_id;
535	
536	  -- Revenue: sum slot_price_cents for booked slots via their booking rows
537	  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.price_cents), 0)
538	  INTO v_slot_rev
539	  FROM flash_event_slots fes
540	  INNER JOIN bookings b ON b.id = fes.booking_id
541	  WHERE fes.flash_event_id = p_event_id
542	    AND fes.status = 'booked';
543	
544	  -- Deposits: sum deposit_cents for booked+deposit_paid bookings
545	  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.deposit_cents), 0)
546	  INTO v_deposit_rev
547	  FROM flash_event_slots fes
548	  INNER JOIN bookings b ON b.id = fes.booking_id
549	  WHERE fes.flash_event_id = p_event_id
550	    AND fes.status = 'booked'
551	    AND b.deposit_paid = true;
552	
553	  -- Top design by booking count
554	  SELECT
555	    fes.design_id,
556	    fed.title,
557	    COUNT(*) AS cnt
558	  INTO v_top_design_id, v_top_design_ttl, v_top_design_cnt
559	  FROM flash_event_slots fes
560	  INNER JOIN flash_event_designs fed ON fed.id = fes.design_id
561	  WHERE fes.flash_event_id = p_event_id
562	    AND fes.status = 'booked'
563	    AND fes.design_id IS NOT NULL
564	  GROUP BY fes.design_id, fed.title
565	  ORDER BY cnt DESC
566	  LIMIT 1;
567	
568	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
569	    'event_id',                p_event_id,
570	    'completed_count',         v_completed_cnt,
571	    'no_show_count',           v_no_show_cnt,
572	    'slot_revenue_cents',      v_slot_rev,
573	    'deposits_collected_cents', v_deposit_rev,
574	    'tips_cents',              v_event.tips_collected_cents,
575	    'top_design',              CASE
576	                                 WHEN v_top_design_id IS NOT NULL THEN
577	                                   jsonb_build_object(
578	                                     'id',    v_top_design_id,
579	                                     'title', v_top_design_ttl,
580	                                     'count', v_top_design_cnt
581	                                   )
582	                                 ELSE NULL
583	                               END,
584	    'artist_id',               v_event.artist_id
585	  );
586	END;
587	$$;

64	      NEW.id,
65	      'low_stock',

67	      NEW.min_threshold,

69	      now()
70	    )
71	    ON CONFLICT (studio_id, item_id)

75	    -- The stock snapshot on the existing row is intentionally NOT updated —

57	    v_old_row   := v_row;
58	  ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
59	    v_row       := row_to_json(NEW)::jsonb;
60	    v_old_row   := NULL;

87	      WHEN TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
88	        jsonb_build_object('old', v_old_row, 'new', v_row)
89	      WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN

93	  );

247	-- ── 6. advance_project_status — state machine with validation + log ──────────
248	-- Allowed transitions (forward):
249	--   planning → deposit_paid | on_hold | cancelled | archived
250	--   deposit_paid → active | on_hold | cancelled | archived
251	--   active → healing | on_hold | cancelled | archived
252	--   healing → completed | active (rollback) | on_hold | archived
253	--   completed → archived | healing (rollback)
254	--   on_hold → planning | deposit_paid | active | healing | cancelled | archived
255	--   cancelled → archived | planning (reopen)
256	-- Non-listed transitions are blocked unless p_force = true.
257	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION advance_project_status(
258	  p_project_id uuid,
259	  p_new_status text,
260	  p_force      boolean DEFAULT false,
261	  p_reason     text DEFAULT NULL
262	) RETURNS void
263	LANGUAGE plpgsql
264	SECURITY DEFINER
265	SET search_path = public
266	AS $$
267	DECLARE
268	  v_old_status text;
269	  v_allowed    boolean := false;
270	BEGIN
271	  IF p_new_status NOT IN ('planning','deposit_paid','active','healing','completed','on_hold','cancelled','archived') THEN
272	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'advance_project_status: invalid status %', p_new_status
273	      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
274	  END IF;
275	
276	  SELECT status INTO v_old_status FROM projects WHERE id = p_project_id FOR UPDATE;
277	
278	  IF v_old_status IS NULL THEN
279	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'advance_project_status: project % not found', p_project_id
280	      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
281	  END IF;
282	
283	  IF v_old_status = p_new_status THEN
284	    -- no-op; do not log
285	    RETURN;
286	  END IF;
287	
288	  -- Validate allowed transitions
289	  v_allowed := CASE v_old_status
290	    WHEN 'planning'      THEN p_new_status IN ('deposit_paid','on_hold','cancelled','archived')
291	    WHEN 'deposit_paid'  THEN p_new_status IN ('active','on_hold','cancelled','archived','planning')
292	    WHEN 'active'        THEN p_new_status IN ('healing','on_hold','cancelled','archived','deposit_paid')
293	    WHEN 'healing'       THEN p_new_status IN ('completed','active','on_hold','archived')
294	    WHEN 'completed'     THEN p_new_status IN ('archived','healing')
295	    WHEN 'on_hold'       THEN p_new_status IN ('planning','deposit_paid','active','healing','cancelled','archived')
296	    WHEN 'cancelled'     THEN p_new_status IN ('archived','planning')
297	    WHEN 'archived'      THEN p_new_status IN ('planning')
298	    ELSE false
299	  END;
300	
301	  IF NOT v_allowed AND NOT p_force THEN
302	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'advance_project_status: transition % → % not allowed (pass p_force=true to override)', v_old_status, p_new_status
303	      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
304	  END IF;
305	
306	  UPDATE projects
307	  SET
308	    status       = p_new_status,
309	    completed_at = CASE WHEN p_new_status = 'completed' AND completed_at IS NULL THEN now() ELSE completed_at END,
310	    started_at   = CASE WHEN p_new_status = 'active' AND started_at IS NULL THEN now() ELSE started_at END,
311	    stalled_at   = CASE WHEN p_new_status <> 'planning' THEN NULL ELSE stalled_at END
312	  WHERE id = p_project_id;
313	
314	  PERFORM log_project_activity(
315	    p_project_id,
316	    'status_changed',
317	    jsonb_build_object(
318	      'from',   v_old_status,
319	      'to',     p_new_status,
320	      'force',  p_force,
321	      'reason', p_reason
322	    )
323	  );
324	END;
325	$$;

329	-- ── 7. mark_session_completed_project — trigger handler on booking complete ──
330	-- Called from trigger on bookings when status → 'completed' and project_id is
331	-- set. Increments projects.sessions_completed, auto-applies deposit per the
332	-- project's deposit_apply_rule, and may auto-advance status.
333	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_session_completed_project(p_booking_id uuid)
334	RETURNS void
335	LANGUAGE plpgsql
336	SECURITY DEFINER
337	SET search_path = public
338	AS $$
339	DECLARE
340	  v_project_id             uuid;
341	  v_session_number         int;
342	  v_project                projects%ROWTYPE;
343	  v_pool_balance           bigint;
344	  v_remaining_sessions     int;
345	  v_per_session_cents      bigint;
346	  v_sessions_after         int;
347	BEGIN
348	  SELECT project_id, session_number
349	    INTO v_project_id, v_session_number
350	    FROM bookings
351	    WHERE id = p_booking_id;
352	
353	  IF v_project_id IS NULL THEN
354	    RETURN; -- booking not linked to a project
355	  END IF;
356	
357	  SELECT * INTO v_project FROM projects WHERE id = v_project_id FOR UPDATE;
358	
359	  -- Bump sessions_completed (idempotent: only bump if this session hasn't been counted).
360	  UPDATE projects
361	  SET sessions_completed = sessions_completed + 1
362	  WHERE id = v_project_id;
363	
364	  v_sessions_after := v_project.sessions_completed + 1;
365	  v_pool_balance   := v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents;
366	
367	  PERFORM log_project_activity(
368	    v_project_id,
369	    'session_completed',
370	    jsonb_build_object(
371	      'booking_id',         p_booking_id,
372	      'session_number',     v_session_number,
373	      'sessions_completed', v_sessions_after
374	    )
375	  );
376	
377	  -- Auto-apply deposit per rule (only when there is balance to apply).
378	  IF v_pool_balance > 0 THEN
379	    IF v_project.deposit_apply_rule = 'last_session'
380	       AND v_project.total_sessions_planned IS NOT NULL
381	       AND v_session_number IS NOT NULL
382	       AND v_session_number = v_project.total_sessions_planned THEN
383	      PERFORM apply_deposit_to_session(v_project_id, p_booking_id, v_pool_balance);
384	
385	    ELSIF v_project.deposit_apply_rule = 'split_evenly'
386	          AND v_project.total_sessions_planned IS NOT NULL THEN
387	      v_remaining_sessions := GREATEST(v_project.total_sessions_planned - v_project.sessions_completed, 1);
388	      -- Split by sessions remaining BEFORE this one completes (so later sessions still get share).
389	      v_per_session_cents := v_pool_balance / v_remaining_sessions;
390	      IF v_per_session_cents > 0 THEN
391	        PERFORM apply_deposit_to_session(v_project_id, p_booking_id, v_per_session_cents);
392	      END IF;
393	    END IF;
394	    -- 'manual' rule: no auto-apply, owner clicks "Apply now" in the ledger.
395	  END IF;
396	
397	  -- Auto-advance deposit_paid → active on first completed session.
398	  IF v_project.status = 'deposit_paid' THEN
399	    PERFORM advance_project_status(v_project_id, 'active');
400	  END IF;
401	
402	  -- Auto-advance active → healing when all planned sessions are done.
403	  IF v_project.status = 'active'
404	     AND v_project.total_sessions_planned IS NOT NULL
405	     AND v_sessions_after >= v_project.total_sessions_planned THEN
406	    PERFORM advance_project_status(v_project_id, 'healing');
407	  END IF;
408	END;
409	$$;
410	
411	GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION mark_session_completed_project(uuid) TO authenticated;

413	-- ── 8. flag_stalled_projects — cron helper ───────────────────────────────────
414	-- Marks projects as stalled_at=now() when they've been in 'planning' with no
415	-- activity_log entries (other than 'created') for 45+ days. Returns the count
416	-- of newly flagged rows.
417	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION flag_stalled_projects()
418	RETURNS int
419	LANGUAGE plpgsql
420	SECURITY DEFINER
421	SET search_path = public
422	AS $$
423	DECLARE
424	  v_count int;
425	BEGIN
426	  WITH recent_activity AS (
427	    SELECT project_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_activity
428	    FROM project_activity_log
429	    WHERE event_type <> 'created'
430	    GROUP BY project_id
431	  ),
432	  to_flag AS (
433	    SELECT p.id
434	    FROM projects p
435	    LEFT JOIN recent_activity ra ON ra.project_id = p.id
436	    WHERE p.status = 'planning'
437	      AND p.stalled_at IS NULL
438	      AND COALESCE(ra.last_activity, p.created_at) < now() - interval '45 days'
439	  )
440	  UPDATE projects p
441	  SET stalled_at = now()
442	  FROM to_flag
443	  WHERE p.id = to_flag.id;
444	
445	  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
446	  RETURN v_count;
447	END;
448	$$;
449	
450	-- Invoked by worker/cron only — service role, not authenticated users.
451	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION flag_stalled_projects() FROM PUBLIC;

662	-- 9. RPC: get_campaign_audience_count
663	--    Updated to accept both old flat shape and new { groups, exclude } shape.
664	--    Always excludes: email_suppression_list entries (when channel includes email)
665	--    and clients with marketing_email=false.
666	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
667	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_campaign_audience_count(
668	  p_studio_id uuid,
669	  p_filters   jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
670	)
671	RETURNS jsonb
672	LANGUAGE plpgsql
673	SECURITY DEFINER
674	STABLE
675	SET search_path = public
676	AS $$
677	DECLARE
678	  v_count     int := 0;
679	  v_channel   text;
680	  v_groups    jsonb;
681	BEGIN
682	  -- Auth check: caller must be a studio member
683	  IF NOT EXISTS (
684	    SELECT 1 FROM studio_members
685	    WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id AND user_id = auth.uid()
686	  ) THEN
687	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
688	  END IF;
689	
690	  v_channel := p_filters->>'channel';
691	
692	  -- Detect filter shape: new { groups, exclude } vs old flat
693	  IF p_filters ? 'groups' THEN
694	    -- New shape — count clients matching any group (groups are OR'd together at top level)
695	    -- Each group has an op (AND|OR between its own conditions) and conditions array.
696	    -- For simplicity of the server-side count, we count the base eligibility pool
697	    -- and apply the exclude list; full condition parsing happens in the worker.
698	    -- Base: marketing-eligible clients in this studio
699	    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) INTO v_count
700	    FROM clients c
701	    LEFT JOIN client_consent_preferences ccp ON ccp.client_id = c.id
702	    WHERE c.studio_id = p_studio_id
703	      AND c.archived_at IS NULL
704	      -- Consent: at least one channel consented (default permissive if no row)
705	      AND (
706	        ccp.id IS NULL
707	        OR ccp.marketing_email = true
708	        OR ccp.marketing_sms   = true
709	      )
710	      -- Exclude list from filter
711	      AND (
712	        NOT (p_filters ? 'exclude')
713	        OR c.id != ALL(
714	          SELECT (value::text)::uuid
715	          FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_filters->'exclude')
716	        )
717	      )
718	      -- Suppression exclusion when channel is email or both
719	      AND (
720	        v_channel NOT IN ('email', 'both')
721	        OR c.email IS NULL
722	        OR c.email NOT IN (
723	          SELECT email FROM email_suppression_list WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id
724	        )
725	      );
726	  ELSE
727	    -- Backward-compatible flat shape (tags / last_visit_days / etc.)
728	    -- Original logic: count all marketing-eligible, non-archived clients
729	    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) INTO v_count
730	    FROM clients c
731	    LEFT JOIN client_consent_preferences ccp ON ccp.client_id = c.id
732	    WHERE c.studio_id = p_studio_id
733	      AND c.archived_at IS NULL
734	      AND (
735	        ccp.id IS NULL
736	        OR ccp.marketing_email = true
737	        OR ccp.marketing_sms   = true
738	      )
739	      -- Tag filter (old shape)
740	      AND (
741	        NOT (p_filters ? 'tags')
742	        OR c.tags && ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p_filters->'tags'))
743	      )
744	      -- Last visit filter (old shape)
745	      AND (
746	        NOT (p_filters ? 'last_visit_days')
747	        OR c.last_visit_at < now() - ((p_filters->>'last_visit_days')::int || ' days')::interval
748	      )
749	      -- Suppression exclusion
750	      AND (
751	        v_channel NOT IN ('email', 'both')
752	        OR c.email IS NULL
753	        OR c.email NOT IN (
754	          SELECT email FROM email_suppression_list WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id
755	        )
756	      );
757	  END IF;
758	
759	  RETURN jsonb_build_object('count', v_count);
760	END;
761	$$;

764	  'M6: Returns eligible recipient count for a campaign audience filter. '
765	  'Accepts both legacy flat shape and new { groups, exclude } shape. '
766	  'Always excludes suppressed emails and non-consented clients.';

771	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
772	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_marketing_segment_counts(
773	  p_studio_id uuid
774	)
775	RETURNS jsonb
776	LANGUAGE plpgsql
777	SECURITY DEFINER
778	STABLE
779	SET search_path = public
780	AS $$
781	DECLARE
782	  v_all              int;
783	  v_inactive_90d     int;
784	  v_new_30d          int;
785	  v_top_spenders     int;
786	  v_birthday_month   int;
787	  v_booked_next_14d  int;
788	  v_unsubscribed     int;
789	BEGIN
790	  -- Auth check
791	  IF NOT EXISTS (
792	    SELECT 1 FROM studio_members
793	    WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id AND user_id = auth.uid()
794	  ) THEN
795	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
796	  END IF;
797	
798	  -- all: marketing-eligible clients (consent row missing = permissive; OR at least one channel true)
799	  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) INTO v_all
800	  FROM clients c
801	  LEFT JOIN client_consent_preferences ccp ON ccp.client_id = c.id AND ccp.studio_id = p_studio_id
802	  WHERE c.studio_id = p_studio_id
803	    AND c.archived_at IS NULL
804	    AND (ccp.id IS NULL OR ccp.marketing_email = true OR ccp.marketing_sms = true);
805	
806	  -- inactive_90d: no booking in last 90 days (among marketing-eligible)
807	  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) INTO v_inactive_90d
808	  FROM clients c
809	  LEFT JOIN client_consent_preferences ccp ON ccp.client_id = c.id AND ccp.studio_id = p_studio_id
810	  WHERE c.studio_id = p_studio_id
811	    AND c.archived_at IS NULL
812	    AND (ccp.id IS NULL OR ccp.marketing_email = true OR ccp.marketing_sms = true)
813	    AND NOT EXISTS (
814	      SELECT 1 FROM bookings b
815	      WHERE b.client_id = c.id
816	        AND b.studio_id = p_studio_id
817	        AND b.scheduled_at > now() - interval '90 days'
818	        AND b.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')
819	    );
820	
821	  -- new_30d: created_at within last 30 days
822	  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) INTO v_new_30d
823	  FROM clients c
824	  LEFT JOIN client_consent_preferences ccp ON ccp.client_id = c.id AND ccp.studio_id = p_studio_id
825	  WHERE c.studio_id = p_studio_id
826	    AND c.archived_at IS NULL
827	    AND (ccp.id IS NULL OR ccp.marketing_email = true OR ccp.marketing_sms = true)
828	    AND c.created_at > now() - interval '30 days';

893	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_marketing_kpis_30d(

898	SECURITY DEFINER
899	STABLE

902	DECLARE
903	  v_total_sent              int;
904	  v_total_opened            int;
905	  v_open_rate               numeric;
906	  v_total_sent_prev         int;
907	  v_total_opened_prev       int;
908	  v_open_rate_prev          numeric;
909	  v_bookings_driven         int;
910	  v_revenue_attributed_cents bigint;
911	  v_bounces                 int;
912	  v_unsubscribes            int;
913	  v_complaints              int;
914	BEGIN

916	  IF NOT EXISTS (
917	    SELECT 1 FROM studio_members
918	    WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id AND user_id = auth.uid()
919	  ) THEN
920	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
921	  END IF;
922	
923	  -- Current 30d window
924	  SELECT
925	    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL),
926	    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_at IS NOT NULL),
927	    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bounced_at IS NOT NULL),
928	    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unsubscribed_at IS NOT NULL),
929	    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE complained_at IS NOT NULL)
930	  INTO v_total_sent, v_total_opened, v_bounces, v_unsubscribes, v_complaints
931	  FROM marketing_sends
932	  WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id
933	    AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days';

935	  v_open_rate := CASE WHEN v_total_sent > 0
936	    THEN ROUND((v_total_opened::numeric / v_total_sent) * 100, 1)
937	    ELSE 0
938	  END;
939	
940	  -- Prior 30d window (for delta)
941	  SELECT

943	    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_at IS NOT NULL)

945	  FROM marketing_sends

951	    THEN ROUND((v_total_opened_prev::numeric / v_total_sent_prev) * 100, 1)
952	    ELSE 0
953	  END;

955	  -- Bookings driven via attribution in last 30d

958	    COALESCE(SUM(b.price_cents), 0)
959	  INTO v_bookings_driven, v_revenue_attributed_cents
960	  FROM bookings b
961	  WHERE b.studio_id = p_studio_id
962	    AND b.attribution_send_id IS NOT NULL
963	    AND b.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
964	    AND b.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show');

966	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
967	    'open_rate',                  v_open_rate,
968	    'open_rate_prev',             v_open_rate_prev,
969	    'total_sent',                 v_total_sent,
970	    'bookings_driven',            v_bookings_driven,
971	    'revenue_attributed_cents',   v_revenue_attributed_cents,
972	    'bounces',                    v_bounces,
973	    'unsubscribes',               v_unsubscribes,
974	    'complaints',                 v_complaints
975	  );
976	END;

73	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_po_from_alerts(
74	  p_studio_id uuid,
75	  p_item_ids  uuid[]
76	)

84	  v_sorted_ids      uuid[];
85	  v_idempotency_key text;
86	  v_cached_ids      uuid[];
87	  v_supplier_ids    uuid[];
88	  v_supplier_id     uuid;
89	  v_po_id           uuid;
90	  v_po_ids          uuid[] := '{}';
91	  v_item_id         uuid;
92	  v_qty             numeric;
93	  v_unit_cost       integer;
94	BEGIN
95	  -- ── Auth: caller must be an active member of this studio ──────────────────
96	  IF NOT EXISTS (
97	    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
98	    WHERE user_id   = auth.uid()
99	      AND studio_id = p_studio_id
100	      AND deactivated_at IS NULL
101	  ) THEN
102	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_privilege'
103	      USING HINT = 'Caller is not a member of this studio';
104	  END IF;
105	
106	  -- ── Feature gate: inventory is Studio+ ────────────────────────────────────
107	  IF NOT public.studio_has_feature(p_studio_id := p_studio_id, p_feature := 'inventory') THEN
108	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature_not_available'
109	      USING HINT = 'inventory feature requires Studio plan or above';
110	  END IF;
111	
112	  -- ── Idempotency check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
113	  -- Sort the input array so order doesn't matter.
114	  SELECT ARRAY(SELECT unnest(p_item_ids) ORDER BY 1)
115	    INTO v_sorted_ids;
116	
117	  v_idempotency_key :=
118	    p_studio_id::text || '|'
119	    || md5(array_to_string(v_sorted_ids, ','))
120	    || '|'
121	    || date_trunc('hour', now())::text;
122	
123	  SELECT po_ids INTO v_cached_ids
124	    FROM public.po_creation_idempotency
125	    WHERE key = v_idempotency_key;
126	
127	  IF FOUND THEN
128	    -- Second call within the hour — return existing PO ids.
129	    RETURN v_cached_ids;
130	  END IF;
131	
132	  -- ── Collect distinct supplier_ids for the requested items ─────────────────
133	  SELECT ARRAY(
134	    SELECT DISTINCT i.supplier_id
135	    FROM public.inventory_items i
136	    WHERE i.id        = ANY(p_item_ids)
137	      AND i.studio_id = p_studio_id
138	  )
139	  INTO v_supplier_ids;
140	
141	  -- ── Create one PO per supplier bucket (NULL = unassigned) ─────────────────
142	  FOREACH v_supplier_id IN ARRAY v_supplier_ids
143	  LOOP
144	    -- Insert the PO header.
145	    INSERT INTO public.purchase_orders (
146	      id,
147	      studio_id,
148	      supplier_id,
149	      order_number,
150	      status,
151	      total_cents,
152	      ordered_by,
153	      created_at,
154	      updated_at
155	    )
156	    VALUES (
157	      gen_random_uuid(),
158	      p_studio_id,
159	      v_supplier_id,
160	      public.generate_po_number(p_studio_id),
161	      'draft',
162	      0,              -- updated after lines inserted
163	      auth.uid(),
164	      now(),
165	      now()
166	    )
167	    RETURNING id INTO v_po_id;
168	
169	    -- Insert one line per item in this supplier bucket.
170	    -- total_cents is a generated column on purchase_order_lines — omit from INSERT.
171	    FOR v_item_id, v_qty, v_unit_cost IN
172	      SELECT
173	        i.id,
174	        GREATEST((i.min_threshold * 2) - i.current_stock, 1)::numeric,
175	        COALESCE(i.cost_per_unit_cents, 0)
176	      FROM public.inventory_items i
177	      WHERE i.id          = ANY(p_item_ids)
178	        AND i.studio_id   = p_studio_id
179	        AND (
180	          (v_supplier_id IS NULL     AND i.supplier_id IS NULL)
181	          OR
182	          (v_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND i.supplier_id = v_supplier_id)
183	        )
184	    LOOP
185	      INSERT INTO public.purchase_order_lines (
186	        id,
187	        studio_id,
188	        purchase_order_id,
189	        item_id,
190	        qty_ordered,
191	        qty_received,
192	        unit_cost_cents,
193	        created_at,
194	        updated_at
195	      )
196	      VALUES (
197	        gen_random_uuid(),
198	        p_studio_id,
199	        v_po_id,
200	        v_item_id,
201	        CEIL(v_qty),
202	        0,
203	        v_unit_cost,
204	        now(),
205	        now()
206	      );
207	    END LOOP;
208	
209	    -- Update PO total from the generated total_cents on lines.
210	    UPDATE public.purchase_orders
211	    SET total_cents = COALESCE(
212	          (SELECT SUM(pol.total_cents)
213	           FROM public.purchase_order_lines pol
214	           WHERE pol.purchase_order_id = v_po_id),
215	          0
216	        ),
217	        updated_at  = now()
218	    WHERE id = v_po_id;
219	
220	    v_po_ids := v_po_ids || v_po_id;
221	  END LOOP;
222	
223	  -- ── Persist idempotency record ────────────────────────────────────────────
224	  INSERT INTO public.po_creation_idempotency (key, po_ids, created_at)
225	  VALUES (v_idempotency_key, v_po_ids, now());
226	
227	  RETURN v_po_ids;
228	END;
229	$$;

2	-- Two modes:
3	--   {"updates": [{"item_id": "...", "min_threshold": 5}, ...]}  — explicit per-item
4	--   {"use_defaults": true}                                       — category defaults for all min=0 rows

12	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bulk_set_min_thresholds(
13	  p_studio_id uuid,
14	  p_payload   jsonb
15	)
16	RETURNS integer
17	LANGUAGE plpgsql
18	VOLATILE
19	SECURITY DEFINER
20	SET search_path = public, pg_temp
21	AS $$
22	DECLARE
23	  v_updated   integer := 0;
24	  v_row_count integer := 0;
25	  v_update    jsonb;
26	  v_item_id   uuid;
27	  v_min_val   numeric;
28	BEGIN
29	  -- ── Auth: studio admin or owner only ──────────────────────────────────────
30	  IF NOT EXISTS (
31	    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
32	    WHERE user_id   = auth.uid()
33	      AND studio_id = p_studio_id
34	      AND role      IN ('owner', 'admin')
35	      AND deactivated_at IS NULL
36	  ) THEN
37	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'insufficient_privilege'
38	      USING HINT = 'Only studio owners and admins can set bulk thresholds';
39	  END IF;
40	
41	  -- ── Mode 1: explicit list ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
42	  IF (p_payload ? 'updates') THEN
43	    FOR v_update IN
44	      SELECT jsonb_array_elements(p_payload -> 'updates')
45	    LOOP
46	      v_item_id := (v_update ->> 'item_id')::uuid;
47	      v_min_val := (v_update ->> 'min_threshold')::numeric;
48	
49	      -- Validate value is non-negative.
50	      IF v_min_val < 0 THEN
51	        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_min_threshold'
52	          USING HINT = 'min_threshold must be >= 0';
53	      END IF;
54	
55	      UPDATE public.inventory_items
56	      SET
57	        min_threshold = v_min_val,
58	        updated_at    = now()
59	      WHERE id        = v_item_id
60	        AND studio_id = p_studio_id;
61	
62	      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_row_count = ROW_COUNT;
63	      v_updated := v_updated + v_row_count;
64	    END LOOP;
65	
66	  -- ── Mode 2: apply category defaults to all min=0 rows ────────────────────
67	  ELSIF (p_payload ->> 'use_defaults')::boolean IS TRUE THEN
68	    WITH updated AS (
69	      UPDATE public.inventory_items
70	      SET
71	        min_threshold = CASE category
72	          WHEN 'ink'       THEN 3
73	          WHEN 'needle'    THEN 20
74	          WHEN 'supply'    THEN 5
75	          WHEN 'aftercare' THEN 5
76	          WHEN 'equipment' THEN 1
77	          WHEN 'apparel'   THEN 5
78	          WHEN 'other'     THEN 3
79	          ELSE 3
80	        END,
81	        updated_at = now()
82	      WHERE studio_id   = p_studio_id
83	        AND min_threshold = 0
84	      RETURNING id
85	    )
86	    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_updated FROM updated;
87	
88	  ELSE
89	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_payload'
90	      USING HINT = 'Payload must contain either "updates" array or "use_defaults": true';
91	  END IF;
92	
93	  RETURN v_updated;
94	END;
95	$$;

**CRIT-1: Undefined trigger function `update_updated_at_column`**
`20260425100001_studio_channel_mappings.sql` lines 39, 75, 110 — three triggers call `update_updated_at_column()`. This function does not exist anywhere in the migration history. The project uses `set_updated_at()` (defined in `20260421100000_messaging_conversations.sql`). The triggers will create successfully but every UPDATE on `studio_instagram_pages`, `studio_whatsapp_numbers`, and `studio_webchat_widgets` will throw `ERROR: function update_updated_at_column() does not exist`.
Fix: Replace all three occurrences with `set_updated_at()`.

**CRIT-2: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` inside a migration transaction**
`20260501200100_marketing_v2_audience_segments_sends_referral_program.sql` lines 649, 653, 657 — three `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` on `bookings` attribution columns. Supabase CLI wraps migrations in `BEGIN/COMMIT`. CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block. Migration will fail immediately with `ERROR: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block`.
Fix: Remove `CONCURRENTLY` from all three index statements (the table is young, lock impact is negligible at this stage).

---

### WARN — Should fix before push

**WARN-1: `20260501200000_inbox_demo_data.sql` is a deprecated seed file that will insert demo data into production**
The file's own header says `DEPRECATED: superseded by scripts/seed/demo/*`. It does a `SELECT id FROM studios LIMIT 1` (non-deterministic) and inserts bookings, payments, inventory items, and missed_calls rows with hardcoded fake UUIDs. If pushed to your production remote this will insert demo junk rows into whatever studio lands first from `LIMIT 1`.
Fix (choose one): Run `supabase migration repair --status applied 20260501200000` on the remote to mark it applied without running it. Or permanently delete the file from migrations/ and use `repair` to align remote state.

**WARN-2: Hardcoded `https://inkos.app/book?ref=` URL in production RPC**
`20260501200100_marketing_v2_audience_segments_sends_referral_program.sql` line 1058 — `bulk_generate_referral_codes` bakes `https://inkos.app/book?ref=` into every generated referral code's share URL. This will return wrong URLs on staging or any custom-domain studio. Should pull the booking URL from `studios.slug` or an `app_url` config.

**WARN-3: `auth.role()` deprecated in RLS policies**
`20260501200100_marketing_v2_audience_segments_sends_referral_program.sql` lines 475, 479 — `marketing_templates` policies use `auth.role() = 'authenticated'` and `auth.role() = 'service_role'`. Supabase deprecated `auth.role()` in favor of `(auth.uid() IS NOT NULL)` for authenticated checks. Still functional but will log warnings.

**WARN-4: Missing `GRANT EXECUTE` on `create_po_from_alerts`, `bulk_set_min_thresholds`, and `generate_po_number`**
Files `20260503100000_create_po_from_alerts_rpc.sql` and `20260503100100_bulk_thresholds_rpc.sql` — both RPCs are SECURITY DEFINER with internal auth checks but have no `GRANT EXECUTE` statement. Without it, only the DB owner can call them. Authenticated users calling `supabase.rpc('create_po_from_alerts', ...)` will get `permission denied`.
Fix: Add `GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION create_po_from_alerts(uuid, uuid[]) TO authenticated;`, same for `bulk_set_min_thresholds` and `generate_po_number`.

**WARN-5: Missing `GRANT EXECUTE` on `get_inventory_dashboard`**
`20260504100000_inventory_kpi_rpc.sql` — this `CREATE OR REPLACE` does not include a GRANT statement. If the previously applied version lacked a GRANT, the replace inherits nothing and authenticated callers will get permission denied.
Fix: Add `GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_inventory_dashboard(uuid) TO authenticated;` at the end.
